entries.description: belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth and what is between them and what is under the soil
entries.subject: belongs what
entries.object: in the heavens and what is on the earth and what is between them and what is under the soil

spans.text: [6] AR: لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحْتَ ٱلثَّرَىٰ EN: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth and what is between them and what is under the soil.
[7] AR: وَإِن تَجْهَرْ بِٱلْقَوْلِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ وَأَخْفَى EN: And if you speak aloud - then indeed, He knows the secret and what is [even] more hidden.

entries.description: there is no deity except Him
entries.subject: there

spans.text: [8] AR: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ لَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ EN: Allah - there is no deity except Him.
There is no deity except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance.
[9] AR: وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ EN: And has the story of Moses reached you?
[13] AR: وَأَنَا ٱخْتَرْتُكَ فَٱسْتَمِعْ لِمَا يُوحَىٰٓ EN: And I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed [to you].

entries.description: the Hour is coming - I almost conceal it - so that every soul may be recompensed according to that for which it strives
entries.subject: the Hour
entries.object: coming - I almost conceal it - so that every soul may be recompensed according to that for which it strives

spans.text: [15] AR: إِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ أَكَادُ أُخْفِيهَا لِتُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا تَسْعَىٰ EN: Indeed, the Hour is coming - I almost conceal it - so that every soul may be recompensed according to that for which it strives.

entries.task_id: and what|is|that in your right hand
entries.description: And what is that in your right hand
entries.subject: And what

spans.text: [17] AR: وَمَا تِلْكَ بِيَمِينِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ EN: And what is that in your right hand, O Moses?"

[18] AR: قَالَ هِىَ عَصَاىَ أَتَوَكَّؤُا۟ عَلَيْهَا وَأَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلَىٰ غَنَمِى وَلِىَ فِيهَا مَـَٔارِبُ أُخْرَىٰ EN: He said, "It is my staff; I lean upon it, and I bring down leaves for my sheep and I have therein other uses."

entries.task_id: so who|is|the lord of you two
entries.description: So who is the Lord of you two
entries.subject: So who

spans.text: [49] AR: قَالَ فَمَن رَّبُّكُمَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ EN: [Pharaoh] said, "So who is the Lord of you two, O Moses?"

spans.text: [50] AR: قَالَ رَبُّنَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَعْطَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلْقَهُۥ ثُمَّ هَدَىٰ EN: He said, "Our Lord is He who gave each thing its form and then guided [it]."
